entries.title: Little Nightmares
entries.definitive_edition: Little Nightmares Enhanced Complete Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the PC Enhanced Edition rather than emulating console versions.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Enhanced PC presentation with 4K/60 FPS-class options and ray-traced effects.

primary.why: The Windows PC Enhanced Complete route is the best version because it combines the upgraded 4K/60 FPS Enhanced Edition features with the Secrets of the Maw expansion pass content, while keeping PC capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Little Nightmares on Steam and use the current PC Enhanced Edition; include the Secrets of the Maw expansion pass/Complete Edition content for the full first-game route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Enhanced Edition supersedes the original for new playthroughs; keep the expansion pass installed for the full first-game story route.

entries.title: Very Little Nightmares

emulation.notes: Play on a supported mobile device; no PC/console release is documented.

primary.why: The iOS App Store release is the cleanest primary route because Very Little Nightmares was announced and launched first for iOS, with the Android release following later as the same mobile prequel experience.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Very Little Nightmares from the App Store and play on an iPhone or iPad; Android is fine if that is your available mobile device.

entries.remaster_caveats: Very Little Nightmares+ is a subscription access route, not a remaster.

entries.title: Little Nightmares II
entries.definitive_edition: Little Nightmares II Enhanced Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Enhanced Edition on PC.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Enhanced PC presentation with ray-traced reflections and uncapped PC frame-rate potential.

primary.why: The Windows PC Enhanced Edition is the best route because it adds ray-traced reflections, improved volumetric shadows, more interactive particles, 4K-class presentation, and uncapped PC frame-rate potential while keeping PC capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Little Nightmares II on Steam and install the free Enhanced Edition upgrade before starting.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced Edition is the preferred route for new playthroughs; original last-generation routes are superseded where the Enhanced Edition is available.

entries.title: Little Nightmares III
entries.definitive_edition: Little Nightmares III Deluxe Edition / Secrets of The Spiral Expansion Pass on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release and keep it updated as expansion chapters release.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with settings and capture flexibility.

primary.version: Steam Deluxe Edition / Secrets of The Spiral Expansion Pass
primary.why: The Windows PC Deluxe route is the best available version because it has the base game, online co-op/solo play, PC capture/settings flexibility, and entitlement to the Secrets of The Spiral expansion content. The caveat is that the expansion pass is staged, so the final DLC chapter must be revisited once it is released.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Little Nightmares III Deluxe Edition or the Steam base game plus Secrets of The Spiral Expansion Pass. Play the base campaign first, then play expansion chapters as they unlock; revisit the entry when the final expansion chapter is released.

entries.remaster_caveats: The expansion pass grants additional chapters and costumes, but its rollout is staged rather than all content being available at initial launch.
